subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a permanent after-compaction-only, current-session-scoped deferred reset method in the public plugin hook contract?
rationale: The capability solves a demonstrated recovery gap, but it creates a new compatibility-sensitive plugin API whose long-term semantics and owner boundary require explicit sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow API
options.body: Accept the after-compaction-only contract after removing Copilot-specific raw authority, documenting availability and completion semantics, and adding live recovery proof.

options.title: Keep reset host-internal
options.body: Do not publish `ctx.api.resetSession`; instead expose an owner-specific context-engine or host callback that keeps session rotation entirely inside core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow API
recommendation.body: Accept the after-compaction-only contract after removing Copilot-specific raw authority, documenting availability and completion semantics, and adding live recovery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The compaction hook lifecycle history makes vincentkoc the strongest available owner for this API-direction choice.
